summary: Master the art of decision support with our Applied Business Intelligence course. Learn to leverage data for informed choices and drive business success.
lede: Applied business intelligence helps managers and other professionals use data and dashboards to make evidence-based planning and performance decisions. The course covers interpreting KPIs and visualizations, checking data reliability, and spotting trends, variances, and risk signals. Participants also practice comparing scenarios and turning findings into clear recommendations for financial, operational, and strategic choices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly use data or dashboards to inform decisions.
audience: HR leaders using BI for workforce
modules: Using Business Intelligence for Scenario Evaluation
BI Tools and Dashboards for Non-Technical Managers
BI for Financial and Operational Decision Support
BI in the Public and NGO Sectors
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of business operations and familiarity with data concepts is recommended. No prior technical BI experience is required.
